notes: No genuine BACK view or true LEFT view of the A7 head turned up. JACK has dropped the A7 from chinajack.com; DirectIndustry and its PDF catalogs return 403; the Shopify, AliExpress and image searches found nothing. The A4C pictures from the official JACK site are the closest stand-ins. The A4C is the same A-series family with the same standard bed, face plate and integrated servo. Its arm and panel styling differ slightly. Official numbers (brochure 2021.05): stroke 35, space 262x130, lift 5/9/13, packing 690x295x550, 40/46 kg. JACK publishes no bed size or table drawing, so those come from the Juki standard (517x178 bed, DDL-9000C-S drawing). JACK A-series heads are sold for standard Juki-cut tables. Derived head dimensions come from silhouette scans of transparent orthographic PNGs (bed = 517) and from photo ratios checked against 262x130. Expect roughly +/-5-8% error. The 'typical' rows are placeholders with no source; replace them with measurements where you can.
